svg.aria-label: My stack as a solar system. three.js and WebGL are the sun. JavaScript and GLSL orbit closest, then Python, Flask and REST APIs, then n8n, PyTorch and Blender Python, then Playwright, pytest, GitHub Actions and Canvas/SVG. Side quests in the asteroid belt: Halo Forge maps, a blue 2003 Strat, ranked R6, star charts.
